【word/document.xml 段12】 Down comforters (羽绒被) are frightening pieces to wash. They’re huge, expensive and filled with delicate material.     1D    .

【word/document.xml 段13】 Start with a spot treatment. If you’re washing your comforter because it’s dirty, spot-treat it first. Most food and dirt spots should respond to regular washing agent. But for old or tough spots, soak the area and leave it overnight. Whichever remover (去污剂) you choose, please remember: “    2 C   ”. Usually, this will involve spraying them, twisting and rubbing to push the spot treatment into the fabric.

【word/document.xml 段14】 Wash it at least twice.    3 G   . Then load your comforter into the washing machine, and run it through a delicate cycle with cold or warm water. Wash it a second time on a quick cycle to clean from the down inside. If your comforter seems a little tight in your washing machine, and you’re not positive it had enough room to move around and expose every gap to the second wash cycle, an additional wash could help.

【word/document.xml 段15】 Dry it well. Thoroughly drying your comforter helps ensure the down inside stays fluffy (蓬松的). You don’t want to cook the down with high heat and damage it, though.     4 E    and remove it from the dryer throughout the cycle (every 20 minutes or so) to redistribute and fluff the down fill.

【word/document.xml 段16】     5B   . A good cleaning every few years will help your comforter last a long time, but you’ll still want to refresh a deflated comforter between washes. Use the dryer for about an hour every three to four weeks to kill dust mites and dry out any moisture. Low heat is ideal. To address dust mites, use high heat for 20 minutes and then lower the heat for the rest of the cycle.
